name: How much does it cost to build a custom BBQ island in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a custom BBQ island in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a custom BBQ island in the Las Vegas area varies significantly based on size, materials, and features. Basic setups with a grill and counter can start around $5,000 to $8,000. More elaborate designs incorporating premium finishes like granite countertops, multiple appliances (refrigerators, side burners, sinks), and extensive storage can range from $10,000 to over $25,000. Material choices like natural stone or high-end stucco also impact the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site consultation to understand your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a custom BBQ island in Las Vegas typically range from $5,000 for basic setups to over $25,000 for elaborate designs, depending on size, materials, and features.
